stopLine: Stop on unprovable process identity, guessed phone model, model-based credential merging, user-rename overwrite, device-credential schema drift, new heavyweight runtime need, product semantics conflict, force push, release, PR, remote deletion, or external publication. Do not write delivery_integrated before user-visible NotifyIcon/menu, real-phone model/rescan, unknown-occupant manual comparison, and target-machine acceptance.
evidenceRefs: Current product authority records the tray-owned service lifecycle, browser-hosted Redline console, QR-only phone authorization, separate Tailscale direct entry, and implementation-candidate boundary. User-visible NotifyIcon/menu, real-phone rescan and Tailscale migration, unknown-occupant manual comparison, and target-machine acceptance remain pending.

DESKTOP-TRAY-WEB-CONSOLE-001 remains user_confirmed; its 2026-08-28 update removes password login and adds an explicit Tailscale QR/connection entry while automatic download, WebView2, and full native UI remain deferred.

Command scripts are wake or emergency entry points; the tray is the service-lifecycle Owner. Password removal does not open access because every phone request still requires a registered device token. Tailscale remains outside physical mDNS advertising.

Web console, QR-only session APIs, Tailscale address/QR selection, same-device preferred-origin adoption, newest-rollout selection with cached-source rediscovery, runtime identity APIs, tray Owner, packaging, and verification consumers are implemented in this branch as a candidate, not as delivery_integrated.

The chain is launcher to single tray Owner to identified Node service to browser console, then QR-only phone authorization with persistent LOCALAPPDATA credentials and optional same-identity Tailscale adoption.

STA NotifyIcon tray, occupant classification, loopback runtime/shutdown APIs, five-area Redline console, LAN/Tailscale pairing choices, portable-package identity, and main-thread tray IPC are present in source; human NotifyIcon and real-phone Tailscale behavior are not claimed.
The implementation uses Windows PowerShell STA and WinForms already present on target Windows plus the bundled Node runtime; Electron, WebView2, online update, and new external runtimes are excluded.

Tray owns service lifecycle; runtime/tray receipts and process proof gate replacement; Unknown/Unproven occupants are fail-closed; QR is the only authorization owner and trusted-device schema/location remain unchanged.

Version/build identity comes from packaged metadata; runtime and trusted-device records live in LOCALAPPDATA; install .env retains Host/Port/LAN name but removes legacy password configuration; Redline tokens are project-owned CSS.

Automated checks cover QR-only authorization, repeated-scan and cross-origin identity reuse, Tailscale classification, model-first naming, device editing, routing, and both duplicate-rollout cases: choosing the newest valid file at first read and switching a cached thread after a newer file appears. Package smoke and Headless tray IPC remain part of the gate.

The next work is human confirmation of the visible NotifyIcon/menu, real-phone QR-only reopen and Tailscale identity migration, unknown-occupant manual comparison, and target-machine portable unzip. Public internet, automatic download, WebView2, full native UI, release, and delivery_integrated remain deferred.
